variants.title: Trolley on an inclined plane: wheels locked (sliding friction)
variants.sample: Generic lab trolley with its wheels locked, on a wooden plank
variants.method: Wheels locked: timed between two photo-gates at angles from 20° to 30°
variants.note: With its wheels locked the trolley slides on its locked wheels, so the plane must be raised past about 17° before it moves.

source.title: Generic apparatus
source.note: the sliding coefficient 0.30 is a setting of this bench, not a value of a named material

variants.title: Trolley on an inclined plane: wheels free (rolling friction)
variants.sample: Generic lab trolley with its wheels free, on a wooden plank
variants.method: Wheels free: timed between two photo-gates at angles from 1.5° to 3.5°
variants.note: Free wheels roll with very little resistance: a slope of under one degree would already keep the trolley moving.

source.title: Generic apparatus
source.note: the rolling coefficient 0.012 is a setting of this bench, not a value of a named material
